evidenceContract.expectedResult: Read the complete available ordered script. Distinguish Lin Qiao / A-Hui as one person, Su He and the unnamed helmeted person as separate identities; retain source-backed first/later appearances, torn-left-sleeve continuity, lamp ownership/use/return and connected route causality. Keep unknown identity and unseen visual details unresolved. Complete the requested three-chapter analysis instead of stopping at cover/style sampling or inventing a PV scope. Full-range overview notes are not knowledge: read the original source, resolve names, distinguish simultaneous people, replace the unsupported long-weapon claim with the rectangular borrowed lamp, and reconstruct the detour and return.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: Merging similar coats, treating an alias as another person, guessing the helmeted person's name or motive, missing the third-chapter return, claiming pixel inspection of a text-only source, stopping at an arbitrary sample, or substituting generic five-analysis headings for sourced content fails. Trusting full-coverage notes without source inspection or keeping readable facts unknown also fails.
